name: g1-replay-lease-source-v2
cmd: set -euo pipefail; out=${SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR:?}; $HOME/.bun/bin/bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$out/install.log" 2>&1; bash research/track-m/prepare-vendors.sh > "$out/vendors.log" 2>&1; $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test core/count-g1-lease.test.ts core/count-replay-forward-lease.test.ts core/count-deferred-checks.test.ts core/count-replay-forward.test.ts core/count-lifted-lease.test.ts > "$out/tests.log" 2>&1; $HOME/.bun/bin/bun x tsc -p . > "$out/typecheck.log" 2>&1; $HOME/.bun/bin/bun x oxlint --type-aware --deny-warnings --disable-nested-config core/count-lifted-load.ts core/count-g1-lease.test.ts core/count-replay-forward-lease.test.ts > "$out/lint.log" 2>&1; for message in research/track-m/g1-lease-port/COMMIT-G1.txt research/track-m/g1-lease-port/COMMIT-REPLAY.txt; do $HOME/.bun/bin/bun x --bun @commitlint/cli@19.8.1 --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$message" >> "$out/commitlint.log" 2>&1; done; printf 'PASS: lease tests, typecheck, lint, commitlint\n' > "$out/result.txt"
